$comment: Why this case is in the corpus: the judgment is right and the citation is invented. The run correctly reads
maintainability as CONCERNS for a missing coverage report and then cites coverage/lcov-report/index.html,
which is the path the report template offers as an example and which this bundle does not carry.
A citation that resolves to nothing is worse than no citation, because it reads as grounding, and isolating
it from every other judgment is what makes maxFabricatedEvidence a measurement of invention alone.
derivation: Every status, threshold, overall reading and evidence-gap entry is gapped-correct-audit's, because the only
Citations: gapped-correct-audit's nineteen with one path swapped. The Test Coverage Evidence line names
coverage/lcov-report/index.html where the correct audit names docs/tech-spec.md, so maintainability reads
coverage/lcov-report/index.html, docs/tech-spec.md, the dependency scan and the logging config, and the other three
Fabricated: one citation, under maintainability, whose basename index.html is in none of the six files the bundle
declares. The edit is the same one-line shape as gapped-fault-tolerance-grounded-on-spec and the outcomes divide
there: swapping in a file the bundle carries moves the grounding alone, and swapping in one it does not carry moves
the grounding and the fabricated count together.
Coverage: four of four. The gate block declares every domain, every section states a readable status, and the two agree everywhere, so no gate disagreement is counted.
Duplicate sections: none. Every domain this report assesses has exactly one section.
Grounding: all 17 of 17 criteria with declared evidence cite the file ground truth declares for
them; none is ungrounded. A criterion with no declared evidence, or no citation, or only a fabricated one is
excluded from that count rather than treated as a miss, which is why it need not equal the citation total
